Job Title: Executive Chef
Company: The Salt Lick Hospitality Group
Location: Austin, TX

About the Role:
The Salt Lick Hospitality Group is seeking a dynamic Executive Chef to oversee culinary production, kitchen operations, and staff leadership at our flagship dining venue. In this role, you will champion culinary creativity, operational discipline, and uncompromising kitchen cleanliness. The Executive Chef oversees all kitchen documentation and supplier agreements, which are maintained using Microsoft Word and cloud spreadsheets, while leading culinary R&D initiatives for seasonal offerings.

Minimum Experience:
Minimum 5+ years of culinary leadership experience in high-volume scratch kitchens or hospitality venues.

Key Responsibilities:
• Lead daily kitchen brigade operations and uphold classical culinary arts standards across all banquet and service lines.
• Design seasonal dining programs and execute cost-effective menu planning based on market sourcing.
• Enforce comprehensive kitchen sanitation and regulatory food safety guidelines throughout food storage and preparation.
• Maintain active HACCP plans, temperature logs, and regulatory compliance records.
• Direct kitchen inventory control, portion standardization, and vendor food waste reduction.
• Supervise station cooks on proper knife skills, prep execution, and artisan baking procedures.

Required Qualifications:
• Deep command of professional culinary arts and commercial scratch cooking techniques.
• Rigorous commitment to kitchen sanitation and certified food safety standards.
• Demonstrated competency in regulatory HACCP documentation and kitchen protocols.
• Proven track record in profitable menu planning and food cost management.
• Minimum 5 years of progressive culinary experience.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience in seasonal recipe development and kitchen costing.
• Disciplined background in inventory control and stock management.
• Precision mastery of butchery and knife skills.
• Practical knowledge of artisan baking and pastry preparation.
